meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询 Azure 历史成本、预测未来支出，并给出减少浪费的优化建议（如找闲置资源、调整 VM 规格）。需在目标范围上具备相应只读角色。
howto.when: 当你提到「Azure 成本」「成本明细」「预测支出」等关键词，或要求降低开支、排查成本激增时接管。不用于部署、开通资源、诊断或安全审计。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个订阅上个月的成本明细
say.note: 按订阅、资源组等范围查询历史成本

say.text: 预测一下我下个月的 Azure 支出
say.note: 调用预测接口给出未来花费估算

say.text: 找出闲置资源，看看怎么降低存储成本
say.note: 走成本优化流程给出减少浪费的建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query historical Azure costs, forecast future spending, and suggest waste-reduction optimizations (such as finding orphaned resources or rightsizing VMs). It needs read-only roles on the target scope.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Azure costs", "cost breakdown", "forecast spending" and similar keywords, or ask to reduce spending or investigate a cost spike. Not for deploying, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

say_en.text: Show me the cost breakdown for this subscription last month
say_en.note: Queries historical costs by subscription, resource group, etc.

say_en.text: Forecast my Azure spending for next month
say_en.note: Calls the forecast API for future spend estimates

say_en.text: Find orphaned resources and ways to cut storage costs
say_en.note: Runs the cost optimization workflow for waste reduction
